title: Finite normalized models before common-stage tensor descent
statement: Fix a prime l, a scheme X, a native LocallyFiniteAdicRealization.Realization R [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-realization-data], and residue-field invertibility of l. For a finite coefficient field E, a CoefficientClosedStructure closed on ambientHom and its CoefficientTensorModels models [def-sf-native-adic-realization-data], define CompletedTensorFiniteModel to retain a ConstructibleTensorCompletionPresentation [def-sf-constructible-tensor-completion-presentation], the ordinary cochain scalar tensor balance isomorphism, its balanced pure-section equation s tensor (x tensor y) maps to (s tensor x) tensor (1 tensor y), K-flatness of every extended integral good complex, the derived ordinary tensor comparison, and its exact K-flat scalar-counit square. No common-stage tensorator or coherence is part of this record. tensorFiniteBalanceSections and tensorFiniteRepresentative spell out those equations. tensorFiniteAgreement is the equality of a supplied common-stage tensorator with the specified composite of R.integral, the inverse ordinary comparison, the quotient-completion map, rational tensor object transport and stageTensor. The existing tensorStage, tensorIntegralObjectIso and tensorQuotientIso are relocated unchanged here; they are the raw localized inclusion, the recorded rational tensor object equality, and inversion of the normalized constructible quotient comparison, respectively.
